signal: Teamworks raised a $235M Series F at a $1.3B valuation in 2025 and acquired Telemetry Sports, Sportlogiq, and Pro Football Focus

email.body1:
Ryan, saw Teamworks closed a $235M Series F and is stacking acquisitions like Sportlogiq and PFF.

Growing through M&A that fast usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps absorb the new products, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Teamworks off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for Teamworks.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, especially with a wider product portfolio to sell. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Teamworks needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for Teamworks.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Teamworks's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know integrating multiple acquisitions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sports-tech motion? I will tailor it to Teamworks either way.
